about: THE IDENTITY WALK truth table (RELEASE_IDENTITY design §2.8 item 3, gate 15). One fixture, three readers: version_walk.ts identityWalkRefusal (the rule every door asks), the image-update channel CLI check-target run from an engine tree that calls itself `running` (test/helpers/engine_cli_tree.ts), and the client's post-restart verdict (update_code_phases.js resolve_health_outcome: a legal walk to a named identity must tell the new tree from the rolled-back one). `verdict` is null (legal) or the WalkRefusal id. `offered` (optional) is what a manifest lists for the target's rung — only the manifest knows it, so the CLI reader skips those rows. A developer-build identity is written `X.Y.Z-dev` (the same spelling as its image tag, which the CLI reader asks as-is; the retired `X.Y.Z.dev` is no identity).
